items.question: By what measure of count and location are certain beings said to undergo torment in this context?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the set in question.
That count is placed within thousands as a locative frame.
The location is specified as womb-diagrams where torment occurs.
items.inference: Torment is assigned to beings situated within eighty-four thousands of womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the beings undergoing torment is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousands of womb-diagrams, they are tormented.
